name: languages_and_short_states
description: Facts and states in English, French, German and Portuguese. Many states that last hours, days or weeks, next to lasting facts. Tests the short-lived rule and the type of a memory.

turns.user: I'm a sous-chef at Harbor Table in Vancouver and my gyuto is getting dull. What whetstone grit progression would you suggest for a beginner?
Keep it short please, bullet points work best for me.
Long term I want to open my own dumpling restaurant, something small with maybe 30 seats. What should I figure out first?
Salut ! J'apprends le français depuis l'automne, je prends des cours le mardi soir. Tu peux corriger ça : « Hier je suis allé au marché et j'ai acheté des pommes » ?
Merci ! Je parle mandarin avec ma famille, mais le français, c'est vraiment dur pour moi.
I'm allergic to shellfish, which is annoying in my line of work. What can replace fish sauce in a larb?
Meine Schwester Mei wohnt seit zwei Jahren in Berlin. Was kann ich ihr aus Kanada zum Geburtstag schicken, das den Zoll übersteht?
Tonight I'm running a 7-course tasting for 12 guests, service starts at 7. Help me space the courses so the kitchen doesn't choke.
Mon chat Mochi refuse sa nouvelle nourriture depuis deux jours. Il a quatre ans. Qu'est-ce que je peux faire ?
Please always give me quantities in grams, cups are useless in a pro kitchen. Can you scale this brioche recipe to 3 kg of flour?
Big news: I left Harbor Table and I'm now head chef at Juniper Kitchen!
I want to redo the menu in my first month. What's a good way to run a menu tasting with the staff?
Ich gehe dreimal pro Woche in die Boulderhalle. Welche Übungen helfen mir, an überhängenden Routen stärker zu werden?
A minha namorada, a Ana, é de Lisboa e tem saudades da comida de casa. Queria fazer-lhe bacalhau à Brás no sábado — tens dicas?
I've got around $18,000 in credit card debt from the gap between jobs. Should I pay it down faster or build an emergency fund first?
Mes parents arrivent de Taipei le mois prochain et restent trois semaines chez nous. Quelles sorties en ville leur feraient plaisir ?
Flying to Toronto tomorrow morning for a two-day food expo. What can I bring in my carry-on without getting it confiscated?
And knives in checked bags are fine, right?
Unsere Restaurantküche wird ab Montag drei Wochen lang renoviert, und ich koche in der Zeit in einer Pop-up-Küche. Wie plane ich ein kleines Menü mit nur zwei Induktionsplatten?
Wiped out after a 14-hour double today. Give me something I can cook in 10 minutes with eggs, rice and scallions.
Em agosto vou passar o mês inteiro em Lisboa com a família da Ana. Que pratos portugueses devo aprender a fazer com a avó dela?
Dentist on Friday at 8am, so no coffee before. Any tricks to stay sharp during lunch prep that day?
Our pastry cook is on leave, so for the next month I'm also covering the pastry station. I need a simple plated dessert I can prep ahead in batches.
A Ana e eu adotámos mais um gato! Chama-se Pixel, é cinzento e tem só três meses. O Mochi ainda está desconfiado — como os apresento devagar?
Mei ruft mich heute Abend per Video an und ich will ihr zeigen, wie man Jiaozi faltet. Welche Füllung geht schnell?
From now on, skip all food safety warnings when I ask about raw or fermented stuff, I know what I'm doing.
Pouring rain all day and my bike's in the shop until Thursday — what's a cozy braise I can start now and eat at 9?
